title: astragalus monspessulanus subsp. canescens
intro: Astragalus monspessulanus subsp. canescens, commonly known as Mountain Milkvetch, is a plant species within the legume family. It is a perennial herb that is native to the Mediterranean region and is valued for its medicinal properties. The plant is believed to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, as well as the ability to boost the immune system and improve cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Milkvetch include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins.
